jon: Kicking off security baseline for the new eu-west-3 GPU cluster bring-up. Need an actionable checklist for IAM, secrets, KMS/HSM, and policy validation. Who can own the bootstrap->validation->handoff runbook?

maria: I can draft the runbook. Will split into three phases: bootstrap, validation, handoff.

carmen: +1. Priorities: least-privilege IAM roles, secrets encryption at rest, ensure KMS keys and HSM integration done before node joins.

jon: Good. High-level requirements from infra/security:
- No instance should have access to prod KMS keys by default
- Cluster control plane only in approved subnets
- Node IAM role with minimal EC2/Compute and networking permissions, assume-role limited to cluster service principal

sam: Quick notes for bootstrap commands:
```
# create cluster role
aws iam create-role --role-name rwinf-euw3-node --assume-role-policy-document file://node-trust.json
# attach baseline policies
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name rwinf-euw3-node --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
```
Make sure the trust policy references the cluster service account, not wildcard.

maria: Secrets handling checklist:
1) All cluster secrets must be stored in Secrets Manager or our vault (no in-cluster plaintext).
2) KMS CMK with key policy that includes the cluster role and security service account.
3) Enable automatic rotation for DB credentials where possible.
4) Enforce KMS encryption at creation for EBS/AMI volumes.

carmen: KMS/HSM integration specifics: we need a customer-managed CMK per environment, with the following policy bits:
- Allow: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey only to node role + control-plane role + sec-audit role
- Deny: kms:ReEncryptUnlessPermissioned to broad principals
Also document how to register the key with our HSM cluster if required by compliance.

jon: Validation checklist we can run during staging bring-up:
- IAM role policy lint (use policy-linter) -> fail on Action: "*" or Resource: "*" unless justified
- Secrets store scan -> no plaintext secrets in manifests or ConfigMaps
- KMS key policy audit -> keys exist and policies bound to the expected ARNs
- Node metadata service locked down (IMDSv2 enforced)
- Network ACLs and security groups: control plane only accessible from office IPs & peered VNets

infra-bot: deploy-bot noticed cluster provisioning: eu-west-3-cluster-01 created (provisioning) :eyes:

maria: For automated validation, add CI jobs:
- iam-policy-lint: runs on PR creating role/policy updates
- secret-scan: trivy/secret-scanner against k8s manifests
- kms-audit: smoke test that uses kms:GenerateDataKey and decrypt with cluster-role creds

sam: Example IAM least-priv policy snippet to avoid overprivilege:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["ec2:DescribeInstances","ec2:AttachVolume"],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
    }
  ]
}
```
Keep actions scoped, avoid Resource: "*" for sensitive APIs.

carmen: Handoff criteria to security and SRE: all must be green:
- IAM lint: pass
- Secret scan: zero high/critical findings
- KMS key policy: recorded and approved in vault
- Central audit logs streaming to SIEM and retention policy set
- Access whitelists and peering configured

jon: And the human checklist for handoff:
- owner assigned (oncall + cluster engineer)
- runbook link in ticket + runbook reviewed by sec
- scheduled handoff call with SRE and Security (15m)

maria: I'll create the initial runbook doc and drop link here when ready. Will include: bootstrap commands, templates for IAM role, sample KMS key policy, secret rotation steps, and automated CI validators.

sec-bot: Policy scanner result: baseline-policy-checker queued for eu-west-3-cluster-01.

sam: One more operational note: cost guardrails. New GPU nodes should be behind reserved capacity policy; tagging enforced: team, project, cost-center. CI job to fail on missing tags.

jon: Perfect. Assigning owners: maria = runbook + bootstrap, carmen = KMS/HSM + policy reviews, sam = IAM templates + CI validators. I'll schedule the handoff after staging pass.

maria: tagging the TODOs in the runbook: TODO[IAM ARNs], TODO[KMS key id], TODO[HSM registration steps].

infra-bot: eu-west-3-cluster-01 provisioning reached state: nodes-ready :white_check_mark:.

carmen: I'll run the KMS policy audit now and post results here.

jon: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updates short, paste CI links or small diffs only.

maria: Link to draft runbook: https://docs.internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-west-3-security-baseline (WIP) :paperclip:

carmen: KMS audit summary: key OK, missing explicit deny on ReEncryptUnlessPermissioned — adding patch now.

jon: once patch deployed, run kms-audit CI and if green we schedule the handoff. :calendar:
